# Akseli

> AI-powered TEF Canada oral practice for Express Entry candidates targeting CLB 7.

Akseli is a web app that simulates TEF Canada oral exam sections A and B with an AI examiner. Candidates practice speaking French with realistic prompts, timed responses, and instant CLB-scored feedback — without needing to schedule a tutor.

## Key URLs

- Homepage: https://akseli.ca/
- Blog: https://akseli.ca/blog
- Pricing: https://akseli.ca/#pricing

## Key pages

- https://akseli.ca/blog/how-to-prepare-tef-canada-oral
- https://akseli.ca/blog/tef-canada-clb-score-express-entry
- https://akseli.ca/blog/tef-canada-vs-tcf-canada

## Value proposition

TEF Canada oral practice (Sections A and B) with an AI examiner. Designed for immigration candidates applying through Express Entry who need CLB 7 in speaking. 30 practice sessions per month for less than the cost of one tutoring hour.

## Audience

Canadian immigration applicants preparing for the TEF Canada oral exam — primarily Express Entry (Federal Skilled Worker) and provincial nominee program candidates.
